_readme: Every HyperFrames registry block and component, indexed by id so a teardown, a brief or the edit can name one. `fits` is our family for it. A sheet may name a row only once it is INSTALLED (`python3 machine/registry.py install <id>` → looks/registry/); the gate refuses an unknown id, and a known one that is not installed. Rebuilt by `registry.py index`.

blocks.title: Dolly Zoom (Vertigo Shot)
blocks.what: Camera tracks toward or away from the subject while the field of view changes the opposite way, so the subject holds its frame size while the background collapses behind it or rushes in. Focal length is solved from dolly distance every frame against d * tan(FOV/2) = const, not keyframed beside it. Requires depth: the subject sits on the z = 0 plane and the content behind it must be layered or genuinely 3D (translateZ at two or more distinct depths) -- a flat element gains nothing from this move.

blocks.title: Chat Message
blocks.what: One message arrives on the measured entry - scale 0.75, 0.12s, growing from its sender's corner. The type is an enum switched like marker-highlight's style: a received or sent bubble with a real tail, a large emoji row, an image, or a link card with title and domain. The atom that chat-thread builds conversations from

blocks.title: Chat Thread
blocks.what: The measured conversation as one mountable scene at full fidelity: status bar, back badge, avatar and name pill, bubbles with real iMessage tails, a Delivered receipt, large emoji rows, a media placeholder, a link card, and typing dots holding the beat. Every message picks its type by prefix - recv:/sent: text, emoji: a large row, img media, card:Title~domain a link card - and heights are measured at mount so any thread fits

blocks.title: CTA Lockup

blocks.title: Cuboid Carousel

blocks.title: Directional Wipe

blocks.title: Domain Warp Dissolve

blocks.title: Drift Hold

blocks.title: Dynamic Grid

blocks.title: Echo Trail
blocks.what: A moving element renders with N ghosted copies of itself at t minus i times delta, opacity stepped down per ghost; one traversal, echoes collapsing into the settled element at rest.

blocks.title: Editorial Flash Overlay

blocks.title: Extended Keyframe
blocks.what: The never-fully-lands arrival: an element covers most of its move in the first fifth of the duration and creeps the rest to the last frame, exits along its arrival vector, and carries shutter motion blur — from any side or by scale, one call per element, plus the ease on its own for any tween

blocks.title: Facet Morph
blocks.what: A faceted low-poly mass of 36 triangles continuously reshapes between three authored silhouettes (blob, mark, badge) with per-facet flat shading that recomputes as the vertices move. Light reads from the upper left; lit facets lift toward a pale accent-tinted tone while turned-away facets fall toward near-black. One calm continuous morph, then a settled hold.

blocks.title: Flowchart Vertical

blocks.title: Focus Blur Resolve

blocks.title: Focus Rack

blocks.title: Focus Swap

blocks.title: Gallery Tunnel

blocks.title: Gesture Tap

blocks.title: Glass Shard Title

blocks.title: Glitch
blocks.what: Shader transition with digital glitch artifacts

blocks.title: Gloss Sweep

blocks.title: Grade Split Reveal
blocks.what: The same picture twice, one flat and one finished, with a hard edge sweeping between them. It stops in the middle long enough to compare, then commits and the graded look takes the frame. Both looks are real HyperFrames color grading run through the WebGL shader, so the preview and the render match.

blocks.title: Grain Field

blocks.title: Grain Overlay

blocks.title: Gravitational Lens

blocks.title: Grid Card Assemble

blocks.title: Grid Pixelate Wipe
blocks.what: Transition effect where the screen dissolves into a grid of squares that fade out with staggered timing — use between scenes

blocks.title: Halftone Dissolve
blocks.what: Scene A dissolves into scene B through a growing halftone dot field: accent ink dots pop onto a fixed grid smallest-first, each opens into a window onto B, until the windows merge and B fully replaces A.

blocks.title: Halftone Field
blocks.what: A full-bleed halftone light field: a grid of dots whose size and colour track a slow flowing simplex-noise field, so broad bands of light sweep across a mostly-black frame like a giant LED wall showing a plasma. Built to run under type.

blocks.title: Headline Slam
blocks.what: A heavyweight headline scales down into frame, lands with a deterministic three-frame shake, holds with subtle drift, and whips upward on exit.

blocks.title: HeyGen Avatar Promo Card

blocks.title: Hand-Drawn Arrow
blocks.what: Wobbled draw-on arrow with straight, gentle, and swoop curve poses, a four-way stroke texture matrix (plain/soft/sharp/spray), and a travel-aligned head-arrival stretch pulse with spring recovery; boils while on screen

blocks.title: Hand-Drawn Boil
blocks.what: Hand-drawn jitter that re-poses every N frames, as seek-safe helpers: pose derives from quantized timeline time through a seeded hash; includes the shared onUpdate dispatcher, a wobbled-ellipse path generator, the boil pose control (off/calm/lively over the family-locked frameDrop), a curvature-adaptive pen-velocity ease, and the completed stroke matrix (plain/soft/sharp/spray — spray is index-seeded deterministic dots, no turbulence) with texture-safe draw-on

blocks.title: Hand-Drawn Box Label
blocks.what: Wobbled rounded rectangle draws on — across the authored stroke matrix (plain/soft/sharp/spray) — or drops in and lands with a volume-true contact squash and bouncy spring recovery, with a handwritten label above or centered; boils

blocks.title: Scribble Callout Circle
blocks.what: Wobbled ellipse draws around a target with optional scribble fill and curved connector; the handwritten label pops in WITH momentum and the drawn shapes absorb the arrival with a volume-preserving contact squash; outline and connector take the family stroke matrix (plain/soft/sharp/spray); boils

blocks.title: Sketched Frame

blocks.title: Text Along a Path

blocks.title: Hand-Drawn Flowchart

blocks.title: Scribble Transition

blocks.title: Speech Bubble

blocks.title: Handwritten Title

blocks.title: Squiggle Marks

blocks.title: Handwritten Write-On Title

blocks.title: Iris Reveal

Classic register dims and desaturates the before state so the after state lands in full color; a thin accent rim rides the iris edge. Callers fill the named before/after slot panels; token-styled defaults render when a slot is left empty.

blocks.title: Match Cut
blocks.what: A circle accelerates into a hard single-frame scene swap, matches the incoming circle exactly, and continues into a smaller resting pose.

blocks.title: Matrix Decode
blocks.what: Random scramble resolves left-to-right into the target text.

blocks.title: Menu Morph

blocks.title: Mesh Gradient Background

blocks.title: Micro Transitions

blocks.title: Minimal Gradient Background

blocks.title: Word-Sweep Highlight

blocks.title: Text Clone Wall Transition

blocks.title: Background Emphasis Type

blocks.title: Minimal Line Graph

blocks.title: Rounded Media Grid

blocks.title: Count-Up Stat Card
blocks.what: Big-numeral statistic with count-up, label, thin progress track filling to value/max, and caption; light and dark schemes

blocks.title: Specs Checklist
blocks.what: Left-aligned specs/traits checklist over footage or a board: rows slide in staggered with an accent underline sweep; light and dark schemes

blocks.title: Hairline Arc Gauge
blocks.what: Thin circular gauge that draws on while its percentage counts up; one helper call drives both

blocks.title: Modal Morph
blocks.what: A small card expands into a full panel, shared-element style: both layouts measured once at mount, the container morphs by transform only (never width/height tweens) while keyed children counter-scale and re-flow onto their own measured targets as pure functions of time.

blocks.title: Morph Swap
blocks.what: Two slotted siblings stacked at one shared center: A holds, then condenses or reshapes into B on a shared 50% 50% transform origin. Condense shrink-fades A exactly as B scales up; reshape morphs the silhouette on scaleX/scaleY, never width or height tweens. Token card defaults render when a slot is left empty.

blocks.title: Morph Text
blocks.what: Gooey text morph — cycles through an editable word list using SVG threshold + GSAP-driven blur for a fluid, satisfying transition effect

blocks.title: Motion Blur
blocks.what: After Effects-style motion blur — integrates each element over a shutter window (shutter angle, phase, samples per frame) by sampling the GSAP timeline at sub-frame times and averaging equal-weight additive copies of the element along its real trajectory, so translation, scale, rotation, 3D rotation and skew all drive the smear

blocks.title: Multi Device Splay
blocks.what: Phone, tablet, and desktop product mockups fan from a centered stack into a proud splayed arrangement with a subtle idle float.

blocks.title: Multiplayer Cursors

blocks.title: Native Notification Pop
blocks.what: One system-faithful notification banner (iOS or macOS) drops in over any scene on an accurate interruptible spring: fast arrival, soft overshoot, settled mass, backdrop blur, app dot, title, one body line. Holds; tucks away only via exit.

blocks.title: News Ticker

blocks.title: North Korea Locked Down

blocks.title: Notes Reveal

blocks.title: Notes Typing
blocks.what: The notes-app confession as a mountable scene: a bold title, then body lines typed character by character on the measured human keystroke rhythm, the caret riding every landed character and jumping down at each paragraph. For a bare prompt line use typed-prompt; for an even mechanical reveal use typewriter

blocks.title: Notification Cascade

blocks.title: Notification Pileup

blocks.title: Number Pop In

blocks.title: Number Wheel

blocks.title: NYC Paris Flight

blocks.title: Offset Path Traveler

blocks.title: Onboarding Stepper Flow

blocks.title: Orbit Card
blocks.what: A single feature card orbits a dot sphere on approved Blender camera motion.

blocks.title: Ordered Dither Pass

blocks.title: Organic Light Leak Overlay
blocks.what: Finite CSS light-leak overlay for memory beats and motivated transitions

blocks.title: Oscilloscope Trace
blocks.what: CRT oscilloscope beam sweeping a waveform across a 10x8 graticule, with closed-form phosphor persistence: the tail decays as exp(-age/tau) and brightens where the beam slows

blocks.title: Outline Draw
blocks.what: A rounded outline that proves a callout by drawing clockwise as a hollow conic-gradient border with a clean closure.

blocks.title: Oversized Cursor

blocks.title: Overwhelm Surround

blocks.title: Page Slide

blocks.title: Panel Reveal

blocks.title: Parallax Zoom

blocks.title: Particle Image Reveal

blocks.title: Particle Text Dissolve

blocks.title: Per-Word Crossfade
blocks.what: Words gently fade into place with a short vertical drift for calm keynote rhythm.

blocks.title: Per Word Rise

blocks.title: Perspective Marquee
blocks.what: A 3D tilted marquee with depth feel as items roll toward the horizon.

blocks.title: Physical Exit
blocks.what: A card exits with physical momentum in toss, drop, or slide mode, carrying acceleration and rotation through the final offscreen pose without fading.

blocks.title: Press Ripple
blocks.what: A cursor decel-arrives from off-stage, lands slightly off-center on a caller-positioned target, compresses with it in lockstep, releases with ink ripple rings, then exits off-stage while the pressed state holds.

blocks.title: Pull Back Reveal
blocks.what: A tight stat detail holds, then one decelerating camera pull-back reveals the headline and supporting cards that recontextualize it.

blocks.title: Pull to Refresh
blocks.what: A mobile list pulls through nonlinear rubber-band resistance, arms at a threshold, commits to a bounded loading indicator, then snaps exactly back to rest.

blocks.title: Push In
blocks.what: A centered headline gains focus through one slow, continuous camera push and a gentle fade out.

blocks.title: Rack Focus
blocks.what: A focus pull with real aperture bokeh: the focal plane travels from a near subject to a far one, so one resolves as the other blows into hard-edged polygon discs that clip to a cat's eye toward the corners. A focus pull only reads against content at two clearly separated depths, so this block carries its own depth-layered night exterior and puts both subject depths on variables.

blocks.title: Radial Surround
blocks.what: Labeled hairline chips assemble around a centered subject on an elliptical ring, then optionally converge inward with a subtle edge dim. The center never moves: surrounded, not zoomed.

blocks.title: Reddit Post Card
blocks.what: Animated Reddit post card overlay with upvotes and comments

blocks.title: RGB Glitch Text
blocks.what: RGB-offset text copies jitter briefly for a controlled glitch window.

blocks.title: Ridged Burn
blocks.what: Shader transition with ridged turbulence burn effect

blocks.title: Ripple Waves
blocks.what: Shader transition with concentric ripple wave distortion

blocks.title: Rubber Band Bumper
blocks.what: An outgoing panel pulls against increasing resistance, holds at tension, then snaps past an edge with overshoot as the incoming panel settles behind it.

blocks.title: Scan Band
blocks.what: A diagonal distortion band sweeps once across a clean wordmark, revealing clipped red and cyan offsets only inside the moving band.

blocks.title: Scramble Reveal
blocks.what: A deterministic hacker-style text reveal that cycles fixed glyph rows and locks the target string from left to right.

blocks.title: Screen Flow Carousel

blocks.title: Scroll Camera Story

blocks.title: Scroll Feed

blocks.title: SDF Iris
blocks.what: Shader transition with signed distance field iris reveal

blocks.title: Separator

blocks.title: Settings Toggle Flow

blocks.title: Shared Axis Z

blocks.title: Shimmer Sweep

blocks.what: The Vox-style annotate gesture: a keyword in a held sentence gets a hand-drawn marker while a thin connector draws up to a mono callout label, all as one choreographed beat on the cue.

blocks.title: VPN YouTube Spot
blocks.what: Snappy Apple-style YouTube insert showing a phone finding and installing a friendly VPN app with sound effects.

blocks.title: Weight Wave
blocks.what: A crest of thickness travels along a headline: each character swells from light to black and leans forward as the wave passes, driven by the wght and slnt variable-font axes rather than by transforms.

blocks.title: Whip Pan
blocks.what: Shader transition simulating a fast camera whip pan

blocks.title: Whip Pan Cut
blocks.what: A full-frame whip pan: scene A whips off laterally with capped directional motion blur while scene B enters in the same direction at matched velocity, on a speed-ramp profile with a decelerating catch. Both scenes ride one strip, so seam velocity is exact by construction. Callers fill the named before/after slot panels; token-styled defaults render when a slot is left empty.

blocks.title: Whiteboard Ink
blocks.what: A whiteboard sketch draws one measured stroke at a time while a pen nib follows the active tip. Preset sketches (bulb, flow, rocket) or your own multi-stroke SVG paths via the strokes slot; a path marked data-ink=accent rides the accent token.

blocks.title: Wireframe Portal Title
blocks.what: A wireframe portal bursts open, the title comes through, then its letters swap into a second phrase.

blocks.title: Wordmark Tiles
blocks.what: A wordmark resolves from deterministic color noise into correctly cropped glyph tiles through a spatially modulated GSAP wave.

blocks.title: World Map
blocks.what: Animated world choropleth with country-by-country reveal, tooltip labels, and rotating globe inset — D3 Natural Earth projection

blocks.title: X Follow Card
blocks.what: A social follow card with avatar, handle, and follower motion.

blocks.title: X Post Card
blocks.what: Animated X/Twitter post card overlay with engagement metrics

blocks.title: Camera Punch-In
blocks.what: Dynamic zoom, slide, and 3D tilt-pan helpers for any wrapper (video, include, card) with cubic-easing defaults and an edge-defocus pulse overlay

blocks.title: Pointer Circle + Countdown
blocks.what: Draw-on annotation ellipse around a target plus a countdown chip that pulses each tick

blocks.title: Comment Cards
blocks.what: Social comments typing on over footage: avatar pop, username and time, per-character typewriter, likes row; image avatars or initials chips

blocks.title: Feathered Spotlight
blocks.what: Dims the frame except a feathered ellipse; the hole's position and size are CSS variables, so helpers glide the spotlight between targets

blocks.title: Scanline Board Background
blocks.what: Textured paper board: scanlines with slow drift, optional pixel grid, static grain, and display text with a blur-focus entrance and chromatic-fringe title

blocks.title: Logo Intro Sequence
blocks.what: Logo stamp pops on a lined board, a kicker line gives way to the title with an accent arrow chip; seeded line distortion

blocks.title: YouTube Lower Third
blocks.what: Animated YouTube subscribe lower third with avatar and channel info

blocks.title: Chromatic Fringe Title
blocks.what: Display title on a transparent root: blur-focus entrance, red/blue fringe that settles then breathes, perspective bow, slow scale drift

blocks.title: On-Screen Display Effect
blocks.what: Grid, scanline, vignette, and sheen overlay plus a 3D-warp wrapper class that makes footage read as if playing on a physical display

blocks.title: Vertical Media Filler
blocks.what: Portrait media filling a widescreen frame via blurred-scale, mirror, or copy side fills; grid texture and foreground contrast lift (images inside the block; keep live footage in the host)

blocks.title: Zoom Through Transition
blocks.what: A transition that zooms through a focal card into the next scene.
